The firm serves custom home builders, renovation contractors, and architects seeking historic wood elements for new construction, additions, and restoration projects.

Corr founded the millwork operation after recognizing that many of his building clients wanted the antique wood aesthetic incorporated into their projects, a demand that existing suppliers could not meet with authentic, large-dimension reclaimed material.
